extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: small fishing boat (cutter), approx. 8.0 x 2.8 x 6.3 m (L x W x H incl. mast), hull depth 2.0 m
extras.notes: front (bow) faces -Y; sits on its keel on z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 0.88 m, white boot stripe above the coral antifouling); separate moving parts with origin on their axis: fishing-boat_propeller (spins around the shaft, local Y in Blender), fishing-boat_rudder (turns around Z), fishing-boat_net_drum (rolls around X in Blender); opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text, no name

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
